title: The Southern Advance
subtitle: Kharkov, Crimea, and the continuing German offensive in Ukraine.
author: R.G. Cruise
summary: The capture of Kharkov, fighting in Crimea and occupation of Odessa show the southern war continuing beyond the Moscow offensive.
outlineTopics: Army Group South's position following the Kiev campaign.
German operations east of the Dnieper.
German 6th Army and the formations involved in the city's capture.
German capture of the city on October 24.
The significance of the city's railway and industrial infrastructure.
Soviet Southwestern and Southern Front operations.
German and Romanian operations in Crimea.
The fighting around Perekop and the Ishun positions.
Civilian experiences in newly occupied urban areas.
The developing Romanian occupation system in Odessa.
Continuing atrocities and persecution in German- and Romanian-controlled territories.
researchStatus: Research brief. Full study and dated military reconstruction in preparation.
